literal: Among poverty, poverty is guest rejecting; among strength, strength is fools bearing.
translation: The worst poverty is turning away guests; the greatest strength is bearing with the ignorant.
modern: வறுமையிலும் கொடிய வறுமை வந்த விருந்தினரை ஏற்காமல் தவிர்ப்பது ஆகும்; வலிமையிலும் சிறந்த வலிமை அறிவற்றவர்கள் செய்யும் பிழைகளைப் பொறுத்துக்கொள்வது ஆகும்.
explanation: The couplet uses a parallel structure to contrast the worst kind of lack with the best kind of power. The phrase poverty within poverty refers to the extreme destitution of being unable or unwilling to host guests. Conversely, strength within strength defines true power not as physical force, but as the forbearance to tolerate the offenses of the ignorant. By placing these concepts side by side, the poet emphasizes that moral endurance is the ultimate strength.
